command: python bench/run.py --name k4-3i-offload-agent-park --gpu 0 --model unsloth/Qwen3-30B-A3B-GGUF@d5b1d57bd0b5/Qwen3-30B-A3B-Q4_K_M.gguf --lock plans/unsloth/Qwen3-30B-A3B-GGUF/Qwen3-30B-A3B-Q4_K_M@9f1a24700a339b09/rtx-5080/cu130-torch2.11/2.lock --traces bench/traces/agent_park.jsonl --corpus judge/prompts/v1.jsonl --max-batch 2 --rounds 2 --evidence-dir k4 --backends holon holon@tier --arm tier=--slots tier=std.state_tier --host-memory 34359738368 --plugin-options state_tier.host.bytes=8GiB state_tier.host.pages=1
method: In-process engines driven by bench/driver.py, one scheduling step per call; client-side timestamps taken when a step returns a token. TTFT = first token - release (arrival, or previous turn's last token + gap); TPOT = (last - first) / (tokens - 1) per request; throughput = output tokens / (last token - first release). Decode steps = steps at peak batch that return no first token; decode tok/s = their tokens / their wall time. Max gap = a request's largest time between two deliveries after its first token. Repeated share = output tokens ending a 16-gram already in their request's prompt or output / output tokens. Paired TTFT = the median over (round, session, turn) of TTFT / the first backend's TTFT in the same round. CPU ms/step = time.process_time() delta around step() on those steps, measured with --blocking-sync (CUDA primary context in blocking-sync mode and torch events created blocking, so waiting for the GPU sleeps and is not counted). Greedy, ignore_eos, fixed output lengths; warmup on the same shapes with other prompt tokens, excluded. HTTP backends (llamaserver, holon_http; bench/backends/http.py): streamed requests, a token timestamped when its chunk arrives; their 'steps' are client polls, so decode tok/s and CPU ms/step do not apply to them.

matched.samplers: top_k / top_p / min_p off on every engine
